canonical_field_rules: All emitted field names are snake_case.
Dates use RFC3339 full-date or timestamp strings.
Numeric facts carry explicit unit and scale fields.
Unit and currency conversions use an explicit envelope with raw value, normalized value, unit, scale, source currency, target currency, conversion rate, and precision.
Corporate action adjusted values declare adjustment factor, method, effective date, raw value, and adjusted value.
Validation failures use a stable error_code taxonomy rather than provider-specific exception text.
acceptance_gates: Statement, ratio, market, news, SEC, peer, provenance, typed boundary, corporate action, and validation taxonomy fixtures validate against declared required fields.
No fixture or example imports live provider SDKs or opens network paths.
Missing optional fields are explicit null values with missing_reason entries.
Stale fields carry stale=true and stale_after metadata.
Rows are emitted in the deterministic order declared by the manifest.
Symbol/date/currency/unit conversions are represented as provider-free typed normalization records.
Corporate action fixtures expose raw and adjusted values plus the adjustment method.
Validation errors use stable taxonomy codes that Leia, Q, and AI workflows can share.
